item.text:
Mistral’s documentation says custom structured outputs are supported by **all models**. This was introduced on January 28, 2025. See the [Mistral changelog](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/changelogs).

The documented usage is:

```python
client.chat.parse(
    model="your-model",
    messages=messages,
    response_format=YourPydanticModel,
)
```

See [Custom Structured Outputs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/structured-output/custom).

A `JSONDecodeError` usually means the model returned non-JSON text, rather than that the model is unsupported. Check the raw response first:

```python
response = client.chat.complete(...)
print(repr(response.choices[0].message.content))
```

Also ensure that:

- your prompt explicitly requests only the required structured data;
- `max_tokens` is large enough;
- you are using a chat-capable model ID;
- your `mistralai` SDK is up to date.

Custom structured outputs are prompt/schema-guided, so support does not guarantee perfect generation for every model or schema. If you only need valid JSON, use `response_format={"type": "json_object"}`; Mistral documents that separately in [JSON Mode](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/structured-output/json_mode).
